images.alt: The image shows the chest X-ray from a coal worker with pneumoconiosis with text that reads, “Deaths associated with coal workers’ pneumoconiosis continue to occur. Consider work history in patients with signs and symptoms consistent with pneumoconiosis, maintain high index of suspicion for pneumoconiosis when evaluating patients who have worked in the mining industry, and encourage miners to participate in (respiratory) health screening, including chest X-ray and lung function test.”

Text reads, “Paraburkholderia in clinical cultures* is linked to use of non-sterile ultrasound gel during percutaneous procedures including blood draws and IV placement. Providers: Use only sterile single-use ultrasound gel products in preparation for or during percutaneous procedures.”

Health care providers: Talk to parents about the benefit of COVID-19 vaccines for their child.”

images.alt: The image shows a newborn baby with text that reads, “Increasing infant RSV immunization through the Vaccines for Children Program. The Vaccines for Children (VFC) Program provides free immunizations, including nirsevimab, to eligible children. An effort to increase VFC enrollment among birthing hospitals was associated with an almost doubling of the number of nirsevimab doses given during the 2024-25 RSV season.”

CDC recommends all babies be protected by either: maternal RSV vaccine given during weeks 32-36 of pregnancy from September through January or infant RSV antibody given to infants younger than 8 months during October through March..

Everyone 6 months and older should receive an annual flu vaccine. Talk to your doctor about flu vaccination.”

checks.label: HTTPS (required for service workers)
checks.why: HTTPS is required for service workers and most install prompts.

checks.label: Web app manifest declared
checks.why: A web app manifest is required for installability and controls how the app appears when launched.

checks.label: Service worker registered
checks.why: A service worker is what makes offline access, caching, and background sync possible.

checks.label: Theme color declared
checks.why: Theme color controls the browser chrome/status-bar color when the site is installed or bookmarked.

checks.label: Apple touch icon (iOS/bookmark icon)
checks.why: iOS uses this icon for home-screen bookmarks and "Add to Home Screen" — without it the icon falls back to a screenshot.

checks.label: Manifest fetched and parsed successfully
checks.why: A manifest that fails to parse cannot drive installability or launch behavior even if the link is present.

checks.label: Manifest declares a maskable icon
checks.why: A maskable icon lets the OS safely crop/mask the app icon on different device shapes without clipping content.

checks.label: Service worker is active (not just registered)
checks.why: An active service worker (not just registered) is what actually intercepts requests and serves cached content.

checks.label: Service worker controls this page load
checks.why: A controlling service worker means THIS page load is being served/intercepted, not just a future one.

checks.label: Meets basic installability criteria
checks.why: Determines whether the browser can realistically offer "Add to Home Screen" / install, based on manifest + service worker + HTTPS together.
